reference.measurement: Approximate placement measured from safe-shield-layout.jpg, mapped to 1080x1920
reference.scale_rule: Uniform scaling; keep the reference canvas centred and preserve image aspect ratios

context_only.note: Existing BPM and receptors are context only; do not render duplicates

text.alignment: Centre the name-and-time group as a whole at [560,1060]; both runs share a baseline

viewer_name.overflow: Single line; ellipsis; do not wrap or shrink the time
viewer_name.input: Literal text, not markup; replace line breaks with spaces

time.reserved_width_note: 80px accommodates the intended 0..999s display; increase for longer effects

runtime.expiry: Hide the whole shield group when remaining_seconds <= 0; do not leave 0s on screen
runtime.clock: Read remaining seconds from the game effect state. The UI must not decrement an independent timer
runtime.pause: Follow the game effect timer and its pause policy
runtime.empty_name: Show the time alone, centred, without an empty name gap

rendering.preparation: PhotoCraft MCP Color to Alpha (#000000, transparencyThreshold=0.065); negligible alpha noise removed; 16px transparent padding
rendering.title: Original SAFE SHIELD lettering is an image; no substitute title font
rendering.right_shield: Reuse the same shield texture without mirroring, as in the reference

sharing.required: Share this safe-shield-layout folder with all contents; no parent parts images are required
sharing.optional: reference.jpg and preview JPGs are review aids; the game uses layout.json and assets/*.png
